description: This file defines the base class `AccountFormBase` which manages account form handling in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for display, validation, duplicate checking, saving, and form rendering related to account entities.

classes.name: AccountFormBase
classes.description: Base class for handling account forms, including rendering, validation, duplicate checking, and saving account data within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate accounts based on name and address criteria.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML form displaying a table of account rows for selection or review.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates HTML form for creating or editing an account, including form fields and scripts.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Constructs the main body of the account form with input fields.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Constructs a more detailed account form suitable for wide layout, including address and contact info.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission to save account data, handling duplicates, validation, and redirects.
